title: The Final Judgment
lead: The Bible's picture of a day when God judges every person and every work. The prophets call it the day of the LORD; the New Testament ties it to Christ's return and speaks of the judgment seat of Christ.

sections.h: The Day that tests every work
sections.b: Paul speaks of a coming Day when each person's work is revealed by fire and tested (1 Corinthians 3:13), when the Lord brings hidden things to light and shows the motives of hearts (1 Corinthians 4:5), and when all appear before the judgment seat of Christ (2 Corinthians 5:10). For believers, he separates the loss of reward from the loss of salvation (1 Corinthians 3:14-15).

sections.h: The day of the LORD in the prophets
sections.b: In Amos, Isaiah and Zephaniah the day of the LORD is a day of reckoning that can fall even on Israel. Paul and the other apostles use the phrase for the return of Christ.
